# Vendored packages

## SheetJS CE

- Package: `xlsx`
- Version: `0.20.3`
- Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz
- SHA-256: `8DC73FC3B00203E72D176E85B50938627C7B086E607C682E8D3C22C02BB99FE8`

SheetJS CE releases newer than `0.18.5` are distributed from the official
SheetJS CDN rather than the npm registry. The tarball is stored here so CI and
deployment installs do not depend on that external CDN.
